title: Closing debug window while Auto Accept Quit is off doesn't end debugging
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.1, 4.7, 4.6, 4.5
- Not reproducible when this commit is removed: afd82d7cb39f247b57fa0d53863b8751c758405f

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable - Zorin OS 18.1 18 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 5500 (BDW GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-5005U CPU @ 2.00GHz (4 threads) - 15.53 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

In a project with Auto Accept Quit turned OFF, running the project in the editor & then closing the window does not stop debugging mode unless a scene scripted to handle quit requests is active.  This means that, if the user wants to handle quit requests in their main scene, but a different scene is being tested, closing the window will not stop debugging. The debugging window remains open without window decorations until debug mode is disabled manually using the Stop button, which is how I initially noticed this bug.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a new project
2. In Project Settings, set `application/config/auto_accept_quit` to False.
3. Run the project.
4. Attempt to close the window.  The window should remain open but without window decorations.  Debugging mode will not have stopped.
5. Add a script to handle quit requests, such as in the example below or in the provided MRP.
6. Repeat steps 3 and 4.  Debugging mode should now stop without issue.

```gdscript
func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what == NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST:
		print_debug("Received a quit request.")
		get_tree().quit(0)
```


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This project contains two scenes, `main.tscn` and `bug.tscn`.  `main.tscn` has a script attached which handles quit requests, but `bug.tscn` does not.  Running the project normally and closing the window should display the intended behavior, but opening `bug.tscn` using the "Run Current Scene" or "Run Specific Scene" buttons should reproduce the error.  You can also set `bug.tscn` as the main scene.

[mrp-debug-close-window.tar.gz](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30343796/mrp-debug-close-window.tar.gz)
